layerGroup.name: BassStrait_predicted_sediment_percent_allClasses
layerGroup.title: Bass Strait predicted sediment grainsize composition: % occurrence all sediment classes
layerGroup.abstractTxt:
This layer shows the predicted percentage cover of gravel, mud and sand across Bass Strait as a stacked (combined) view. Predictions were developed from Marine Sediments (MARS) samples and environmental and spatial predictors including bathymetry, seabed shear stress and hydrodynamic variables.
The dataset was produced through the Resourcing Australia’s Prosperity Initiative (RAPi) Offshore Energy Project. See https://doi.org/10.26186/151229 for additional information.
